result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). I didn't add tests for the new cases, and I didn't run any path through the rules by hand.

- **The change:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` now use `[^/\\]*` after `mock` / `__mock`. Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now matches, whatever the rest of the name is. That includes plain `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟`.
- **Folder boundary:** The character class stops at `/` and `\`, so the match stays within one folder name. The leading `/` is still required, so `remock/` and `demo/` don't match. `mock.java` and `mockery.java` don't match either, because there is no `/` after `mock...`.
- **Old matches:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- **Backslash paths:** Windows paths work because `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already tries a `/`-normalised copy of the path.
- **Tests:** The existing `ScopingConventions*` tests in the `codeanalyzer` module pass.
